title: Morning Brief
intro_md: Type "more on G3" (or any code) in chat, or tap More info on the page and paste the request, for a deep dive.

items.headline_md: Update: **Spain** train crash toll rises to 68
items.summary_md: Two high-speed trains collided near Toledo on the Madrid–Andalusia line; Spain declared three days of mourning, and investigators are looking at an IT failure and a control-centre go-ahead before the crash.

items.headline_md: **Iran** rejects Qatar's plan to end the war with the **US**
items.summary_md: Tehran called the proposal unacceptable, while CNN reports US forces could launch a big operation within four days of Trump's approval after the Nov. 3 midterms.

items.headline_md: **US** reportedly also pursuing a temporary **Iran** peace deal
items.summary_md: A Semafor report says Washington is negotiating a temporary agreement with Iran, though significant obstacles remain; Trump confirmed talks through mediators.

items.headline_md: Russian drone strike on a **Ukrainian** railway station kills at least 13
items.summary_md: The attack came as Moscow and Kyiv prepare to resume US-mediated peace talks next month.

items.headline_md: Update: **Africa CDC** warns **Ebola** could reach the UK
items.summary_md: Jean Kaseya said the outbreak could spread to the UK and other countries without more funding for preparedness and treatment.

items.headline_md: **Alphabet** misses, **Microsoft** beats
items.summary_md: Alphabet earned $2.12 a share vs. $3.03 expected on $127.6B revenue, while Microsoft posted $4.92 vs. $4.72 on $92.3B, helped by Azure.

items.headline_md: Update: **Fed** holds rates at 3.75%–4%
items.summary_md: The 10–2 vote had Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack dissenting in favor of a hike; traders see an 81% chance of a December hike.

items.headline_md: **Eli Lilly** beats and raises guidance
items.summary_md: Q3 revenue hit $24.4B, up 39%, and Lilly lifted its 2026 revenue outlook to $91B–$92B on Mounjaro and Zepbound demand.

items.headline_md: **Volkswagen** posts a €5.8B quarterly loss
items.summary_md: Europe's largest carmaker blamed intense Chinese competition.

items.headline_md: **ECB**'s **Lagarde** to step down early
items.summary_md: Christine Lagarde will leave on Feb. 7, 2027, about nine months before her term ends, the ECB said ahead of today's rate decision.

items.headline_md: **Samsung** chip profit jumps 15-fold, but shares fall
items.summary_md: The stock slid about 4% on no new shareholder-return plans; Samsung will raise 2026 capex by more than 60%.

items.headline_md: **Atari** hires the **Crossy Road** creator to run mobile
items.summary_md: He'll lead Atari's mobile business and cross-platform strategy.

items.headline_md: **Unity** and **PvX** team up on ad-spend financing
items.summary_md: Eligible studios get Unity Ads credits and user-acquisition financing without giving up equity.

items.headline_md: **Steam** reportedly makes devs play their game before review
items.summary_md: Developers must log at least five minutes of runtime through a developer account first; Valve also said it won't gatekeep AI-made games.

items.headline_md: **Pokémon Unite** is shutting down in 2027
items.summary_md: TiMi's MOBA goes offline on mobile and Switch on March 23, 2027.

items.headline_md: **Nintendo Indie World**: **Witchbrook** dated, **Sword of the Sea** out today
items.summary_md: Witchbrook lands Jan. 28, 2027, Sword of the Sea hits Switch 2 Oct. 29, and Slime Rancher 2 comes to Switch 2 in January.

items.headline_md: **Don't Nod** restructures to avoid insolvency
items.summary_md: The Life is Strange studio faces internal unrest as it tries to shore up its finances.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: **Switch 2 breakthrough today.** Wii U general lifter watch: still no public repo or release (checked GitHub, r/decomps and the web).

items.headline_md: **Switch 2** exclusives **Mario Kart World** and **Splatoon Raiders** run off-console
items.summary_md: Days after the Switch 2 jailbreak, Will Faust showed Mario Kart World on Mac and iPhone via a private nxnative fork, and a private Eden build gets Splatoon Raiders to character select on PC; both are rough and unreleased.

items.headline_md: **Skybound**: an early **Tears of the Kingdom** recomp for Windows
items.summary_md: NotRexed's open-source project translates TOTK 1.0.0's Switch code to C and renders through WebGPU; it's an early beta with graphics bugs that you build from your own dump.

items.headline_md: **Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream** gets an experimental PC recomp
items.summary_md: Tomodachi LTD Recomp turns the Switch game's ARM code into native x86-64 but still leans on suyu-derived code for graphics, audio and services; a fully native port is in development.

items.headline_md: **Super Kirby Clash** recompiled for PC on **LASRecomp**
items.summary_md: KirbyRecomp alpha 0.1.0 translates the Switch game's ARM64 code to C on your PC with a Vulkan renderer; you need your own dump.

items.headline_md: PS3 recomps: **Ratchet & Clank: A Crack in Time** playable to the end, **Killzone 3** partly playable
items.summary_md: RACiT 0.8 runs start to finish with known bugs via ps3recomp, and Project Helghast's first builds translate Killzone 3 to Direct3D 12.

items.headline_md: **Xenia Canary** fixes black tiling in 30+ **Unreal Engine 3** games
items.summary_md: The Xbox 360 emulator now implements Xenos MSAA sample positions.

items.headline_md: **Clayface** leads Tuesday with $3.37M
items.summary_md: DC's villain film is at $29.7M after five days, per Box Office Mojo's Tuesday Oct. 27 chart.

items.headline_md: **Street Fighter** passes $48.6M
items.summary_md: Paramount's video game movie was No. 2 Tuesday with $1.02M in its 12th day.

items.headline_md: Quiet Halloween weekend: **You Can See Everything** could hit No. 1
items.summary_md: With Halloween on Saturday and no big openers, Boxoffice Pro sees A24's documentary at $12M–$17M vs. Clayface at $10M–$15M.

items.headline_md: Laika's **Wildwood** is a word-of-mouth hit
items.summary_md: It opened to $12.27M on 2,596 screens with 100% on Rotten Tomatoes and an A CinemaScore, per Boxoffice Pro.

items.headline_md: **Jumanji: Open World** trailer drops
items.summary_md: Sony's trilogy finale with Dwayne Johnson, Jack Black, Kevin Hart and Karen Gillan opens Dec. 25.

items.headline_md: **Google** unveils **Gemini 4 Carbon**, gated to cyber defenders first
items.summary_md: Google calls it its strongest model; intro API prices are $2/$10 per million tokens with no public API date yet.

items.headline_md: **GitHub Copilot Fusion** now picks the model for you
items.summary_md: Generally available on every Copilot plan, it routes prompts across models based on an effort level you choose.

items.headline_md: **New York** bans chatbots from posing as people with kids
items.summary_md: Gov. Hochul's new law carries fines up to $25,000 per violation and pushes age checks onto chatbot makers.

items.headline_md: **Microsoft** booked $10B in revenue from **OpenAI**
items.summary_md: TechCrunch also notes Microsoft disclosed Azure revenue of $33.2B.

items.headline_md: **Google** takes AI Mode ads global as Search growth slows
items.summary_md: Ads in AI Mode expand to international markets, plus multi-turn ads in the US, as Search revenue growth slowed to 12%.

items.headline_md: **Apple** launches a touchscreen **MacBook Pro**
items.summary_md: The M5 Pro/Max models add a touch OLED screen and up to 128GB of memory, from $2,899, shipping Nov. 6.

items.headline_md: Hacker steals data on thousands of **DHS** employees
items.summary_md: The stolen personnel data includes CBP and ICE agents.

items.headline_md: **Chrome**'s AI Autofill can now pull from **Gmail**
items.summary_md: It digs through your email to fill out forms.

items.headline_md: **Nasdaq** futures down about 1%
items.summary_md: At 4:02 AM AZ, Nasdaq 100 futures were −0.93%, S&P 500 −0.2% and Dow −0.09%, ahead of PCE inflation and Q3 GDP.

items.headline_md: **Alphabet** −10.4%, **Microsoft** +2.1% premarket
items.summary_md: Alphabet is on track to lose more than $400B in value if the drop holds (quoted 4:37 AM AZ).

items.headline_md: **Fortinet** −26%, **ServiceNow** −20% premarket
items.summary_md: Software stocks are sliding broadly; Glaukos and Insmed are among the gainers (checked about 5 AM AZ).

items.headline_md: **Oil** eases to about $102
items.summary_md: WTI slipped Thursday on renewed US–Iran diplomacy after settling at $102.78 (+2.9%) Wednesday (report at 4:20 AM AZ).
Quoted at 5:06 AM AZ.

items.headline_md: **Bitcoin** about $80,100, down 1.4%
items.summary_md: It dipped to $79,600 before bouncing (quoted 4:11 AM AZ).

items.headline_md: **Phoenix**: partly sunny, high near 86, low around 63; ⚠️ Flood Watch
items.summary_md: Dry today, then a slight chance of showers and storms after midnight (30% tonight, 0.1 to 0.25 inch possible). NWS Flood Watch runs until 6 PM AZ Friday, Oct. 30.

items.headline_md: **Show Low**: mostly cloudy, high near 68, low around 42
items.summary_md: Rain chance about 1% today and 4% tonight; south wind gusting to 23 mph. No alerts.

items.headline_md: **Snowflake**: partly sunny, high near 72, low around 41
items.summary_md: Rain chance about 1% today and 2% tonight; gusts to 25 mph. No alerts.

items.headline_md: Frames Games' list of every **Switch** game running natively on PC
items.summary_md: One table of all 13 Switch PC ports on GitHub, with versions, requirements and the catch for each, from LASRecomp to Metroid Dread.
